title: Identification of an inclusion from local Cauchy data for time-harmonic elastic waves
summary: We consider the inverse problem of determining an inclusion contained in an elastic body undergoing time-harmonic oscillations at fixed frequency by local Cauchy data. Both the body and the inclusion are made by different homogeneous linearly elastic isotropic materials, with piecewise constant mass densities. Under mild a priori regularity assumptions on the unknown inclusion and with no spectral hypothesis on the frequency, we establish a logarithmic-type stability estimate by local Cauchy data.
